referees.quote: These findings are interesting and important for the applicable devices. I have a few questions about the manuscript before I make a recommendation.

As it stands, I cannot at present recommend publications of the manuscript... I encourage the authors to address in the necessary details comment #4 which I believe invalidates most of the conclusions

note: First round is Version 0; the file shows no transfer from another journal. R1 gave no recommendation and only posed three questions (magnetic domains, Sn vacancies, one unclear sentence) in a positive tone, so I inferred minor revision. That call is borderline: the domain and Sn-vacancy questions could be read as requests for substantial new analysis. R2 borders on reject, saying comment #4 'invalidates most of the conclusions' and 'there is little sense to continue reviewing'. I chose major revision because 'at present' and the invitation to address the comments imply resubmission is possible, and R2 asked for substantial new data (XRR, EELS, single-shot ns-pulse switching, control experiments on thin films). For context only: in later rounds R2 supported publication after minor changes and R1 recommended publication in Version 2.
